question:
Read the following text!

Air pollution is caused by many things like the increasing number of cars on our roads, growing cities, the fast development of our economy and industrialization.

Air pollution as we know it today, started with the industrial revolution in Europe in the 19th century. In the last few decades, it has become the major problem for our environment.

When harmful elements get into the air they may cause health problems and can also damage the environment, buildings and soil. They make the ozone layer thinner and lead to the warming of the earth's atmosphere and climate changes.

Our modern life style has led to dirtier air over the years. Factories, vehicles of all kinds, the growing number of people are some things that are responsible for our pollution today. But not all pollution in the air is caused by people. Forest fires, dust storms and volcano eruptions can lead to the pollution of the atmosphere.

The text mostly shows us about ...
options: the causes of air pollution for human's life
the effect of air pollution on ozone layer
how air pollution increases every year
rationale: The passage gives broad information about air pollution, including causes, history, effects, and sources. Therefore, the best main idea is general information about air pollution.

question:
Read the following text!

In the very center of Geneva's Old Town is Bourg-de-Four Square, a must-visit square, the oldest place in Geneva, where the Roman marketplace used to trade its wares. Now a touristy locale is full of exclusive shopping opportunities and the great place to have a cup of cafe.

The middle of the square is decorated by simple marble medieval fountains. Around the square are restaurants and coffee shops with very popular outside seating, often full of people for its unique historic and authentic atmosphere. The most famous are Cafe de Bourg-de-Four, La Clemence and Restaurant au Carnivore.

At Christmas time the square is romantically decorated and highlighted by rows of lamps. During hot sunny days, it will be full of local people and tourists as well, enjoying their day. It is astonishingly brilliant.

On Place Bourg-de-Four you will also find souvenir shops, newspaper stands, a police station, and ice cream parlor combined with an Italian restaurant, offering ice cream for 3,50 CHF and several affordable snacks. Chocolates Tea Room is a cozy tourist shop with a wide selection of delectable Swiss chocolates.

The intention of the writer is to ...
options: promote the good place for tourists to stay.
give detail information about the tourism site.
tell the most interesting place to visit with family.
announce the information for all tourists to visit the place.
rationale: The text describes Bourg-de-Four Square by giving details about its location, history, facilities, atmosphere, shops, restaurants, and activities. The writer's intention is to give detailed information about the tourism site.

subject: bahasa_inggris
question:
Read the following text!

It happened one evening when my friend Segaran and I wanted to go to visit our friend. I had a bicycle and Segara did not. So, as usual, he sat side-saddle on the horizontal bar of the bicycle while I pedaled. We had done it many times before; so it should not be any problem.

As we passed by a stream, I made the mistake of going too near the bank. The rain had softened the soil and it could not hold our combined weight. So, we were tumbling head over heels into the stream as the bank gave way beneath us.

Splash! Splash! Splash! We plunged into the river, bicycle first, followed by Segaran and me. Normally the stream is only a few centimeters deep with foul black water. The water prevented us from getting badly injured but we also had to pay the price of gulping some of it. It tasted horrible. Segaran got the worst of it for being sandwiched between the bicycle and me, but it was not too bad. We had only a few cuts and bruises. Our pride was far more hurt.

We retrieved ourselves and the bicycle from the stream. We were both so dirty and soaking wet that we decided to return home.

We walked all the way home. I had to push the bicycle because its front wheel was bent out of shape. From that moment I vowed never to carry anyone on a bicycle.

The main idea of the third paragraph is ...
options: the writer's regret for taking one on a bicycle.
the condition of soil near the bank of the river.
the incident of the writer and his friend falling to the river.
the writer's friend got the worst the pain due to the falling.
rationale: The third paragraph describes the moment they plunged into the river and the immediate effects of the fall. The main idea is the incident of the writer and his friend falling into the river.
